item.title: Netanyahu seeks more Trump support before tight Tuesday election
item.description: TEL AVIV, Israel — Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, fighting for political survival in Tuesday's elections, has pleaded with President Trump for more support.

item.title: Campaigns use grieving families in midterm attack ads
item.description: The 2026 midterms have become deeply personal as campaigns use other people's family tragedies as political ammunition, sometimes over the objections of those families.

item.title: Lula defeats Bolsonaro in Brazil presidential election
item.description: Brazil President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva was elected to a fourth, nonconsecutive term in the nation's presidential election, according to early results.

item.title: Meta's $42B in penalties serves as warning to AI
item.description: A wave of litigation has caught up to Meta, resulting in $42 billion in recent penalties and settlements, a strong reminder to AI companies.
